# Historical subscription name-column reads reject invalid row indices

The historical fix rejects negative or out-of-range rows before nameColumn accesses in GetCellText and GetCellValue. It returns NS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG. The subscribedColumn path is outside the added guard. The accepted class no longer implements nsITreeView and those cell methods are absent, so this evidence describes the historical fix rather than a current tree-view contract.

Scope: subscription-tree-history.
